notes: Authenticated as masenf through the local GitHub CLI and GitHub connector; the final listing contains 116 open PRs and all 87 non-drafts have current-head review/check state or a verified unchanged carry-forward.
Review and CI state came from authenticated GitHub REST, GraphQL, and connector reads; local git merge-tree supplied authoritative conflict status.
Git measurements and merge-tree use main 9c64f1eea6a2522e5c7bb48cc314bc8657058781; local merge-tree is authoritative for clean versus conflicting.

Waiting on maintainer requires a clean local merge, SUCCESS with at least 60 GitHub Actions checks, zero unresolved review threads, and newer author activity; PR creation is the baseline when no peer maintainer has interacted.
Every red or cancelled PR has a current log- or check-diagnostic-derived finding; superseded failures with successful same-head replacements are not treated as substantive blockers.
The label audit covered all 116 open PRs, drafts included; documentation requires real docs paths, while breaking labels require a current public-contract change.
audit_corrections: Rejected #7653's cross-repository bot rule as unsupported by this repository and rebucketed its two addressed bot threads as maintainer clicks.
Removed #7661 from strict waiting and one-fix-away while its author-owned release validation remains open.
Added an active-ask score penalty so author blockers cannot outrank clean re-review candidates; #7578 re-entered the top 15.
Narrowed Fast Lane to trivial diffs, docs/config-only changes, or already-approved small diffs.
Corrected renderer routing so explicit issue references link to /issues/N rather than /pull/N.
caveats: Latest commit or timeline activity is used as the push-time proxy because the connector does not expose a separate pushed timestamp.
Workflow-gated fork PRs show only reviewer-bot checks; they are not classified as green until the full Actions suite runs.
Automated review threads count as open issues when unresolved, but bots never count as maintainer interaction.
Historical review commit ancestry is not asserted where force-pushed review SHAs are no longer reachable; current heads and counting approvals are verified.
